newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TENNIS-DUTCH NARROW GAP IN DAVIS CUP TIE WITH ROMANIA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DUTCH NARROW GAP IN DAVIS CUP TIE WITH ROMANIA.

text.p: The Netherlands' strong doubles pair of Paul Haarhuis and Jacco Eltingh won an easy first point for their country on Saturday, beating Romania's second-string of Ion Moldovan and Razvan Sabau in their Davis Cup World Group first round tie.
The Dutch pair, currently second in world rankings, won 7-6 (7-4) 6-4 6-3 to make the tie 2-1 to the Romanians who won both opening singles.
Romania's Davis Cup captain Florin Segarceanu, seeking to give a breather to his top singles men, fielded reserves Moldovan and Sabau just an hour ahead of Saturday's doubles.
In Sunday's deciding singles, Adrian Voinea plays Jan Siemerink while Andrei Pavel is up against Haarhuis.
